verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes an API Reference page at /api/latest/ and a markdown version of it. Neither item's content documents API version numbers or a deprecation policy; the 'latest' in the URL only hints at versioning and is not affirmative evidence. Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for an observability SaaS, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
